chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Ash'ari, from Ibn al-Qaddah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: 'The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) sent me regarding the demolishing of the graves and breaking of the pictures.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (title for Imam Ali)

ai.seo_question: What was the mission of Imam Ali regarding graves and images according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the practical application of *tawhid* by Imam Ali (peace be upon him) under the Prophet's directive to remove physical symbols of idolatry, specifically graves and images. In Shia scholarship, this is often interpreted not merely as a historical event but as a foundational principle for purifying spaces of worship from *shirk* and *bid'ah*, ensuring that devotion remains directed solely to God. The emphasis on 'breaking images' underscores the rejection of visual representations that might lead to idolatrous practices.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> sent me<sup>asws</sup> regarding the demolishing of the graves and breaking of the pictures’.
en.sarwar: 11. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad Ja‘far ibn Muhammad al-Ash‘ariy from ibn al-Qaddah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that ’Amir al-Mu’minin has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, sent me to destroy the graves and pictures (forms).”’
